_doc: FM3 material rules by pixel shader hash, for tools/fir_world.py (a first slice of the FM3 profile's material archetypes, SCENE_API.md). color_const: the PS constant (cN, pixel-shader numbering) holding the albedo colour. texture: the slot of the albedo texture; texture_mode 'over_alpha' composites it over the colour by its alpha (liveries over paint), 'multiply' multiplies. alpha_texture/alpha_channel: the slot and channel giving coverage (decals). color: a fixed albedo. alpha: a constant coverage (glass). drop: leave the draw out (effects that only read render targets made during the frame). unlit: the sky and other emissive surfaces (glTF KHR_materials_unlit).
